I placed it after `tax_cents`. Anyone constructing `Invoice` with positional arguments past `tax_cents` would see `ledger_ref` and `lines` shift by one position.

`finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents`, so the discount isn't applied to the amount sent to the ledger. I left it alone because you only asked for the field. Changing the posted amount affects real ledger postings, so tell me if you want the discount subtracted there.
